after_soundtrack.title: LittleBigPlanet PS Vita: Soundtrack
after_soundtrack.curator_note: Commissioned music and licensed recordings give Sackboy's portable adventure its playful character.
after_soundtrack.recording_collection_scope: One actual available148minute originalPSVita-labelled archival collection with no published chapters or description. Game includes commissioned and licensed music; no certified complete roster, cue timings, master identity or exclusive per-track composers invented.
